From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>

Subject: Post-event promo credits for DataOps Summit — code qty & expiry

Hi Sarah —

Great meeting last week. The DataOps Summit follow-up went really well and a few teams asked about an extra trial window to evaluate Redwood on their pipelines. Can BrightConf accept a small batch of post-event promo codes we can distribute to attendees that did not convert during the demo?

Quick ask: would you be able to accept 100 unique one-time promo codes that grant a 60‑day free trial (no CC required)? If 100 is too many, we can reduce to 50–75. We want codes to expire 90 days after issuance, with a visible campaign tag so you can track redemptions on your side.

I'll attach a draft mutual action (MA) plan and a CSV of placeholder codes for ops (we'll replace placeholders with final codes on approval).

High-level distribution plan:
- BrightConf sends the codes in a post-event email to 1,200 registrants who attended but didn't start a trial.
- Redemption window: 60 days of trial, code expiry 90 days after send.
- Usage cap: one code per account.

If this works, I need a short approval from you by Wednesday so we can finalize codes and the tracking link.

Thanks —
Soojin Lee
Partnerships, Programs
Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0182

Attachments: DataOps_Summit_MA_plan_v3.pdf (draft MA plan), promo_codes_batch_v1.csv (placeholders)

Subject: Re: Post-event promo credits for DataOps Summit — code qty & expiry

Thanks for the note, Soojin.

A couple of quick internal checks before we send to Sarah:
1) Promo quantity — finance prefers we cap the commit to 75 complimentary trials for this channel (historically better conversion and keeps cost exposure predictable).
2) Trial length — product sign-off for a 60‑day trial is fine, but legal wants the expiry wording to explicitly state codes are void after 90 days from send date.
3) Tracking — we should require a query param on the BrightConf CTA so we can attribute redemptions to the event. Ask ops to add the param to the post-event email.

Karthik — can you confirm whether the 75-code cap needs an alternate approval path for high-priority enterprise leads (i.e., if a larger account asks for a custom code)?

If all good, Soojin please respond to Sarah with the updated numbers and attach the final CSV.

—Marissa
